scientific_integrity: The universal horizon bound is derived analytically from an exact weighted storage identity and a compact-uniform quadratic dissipation estimate. Exact-rational tests verify algebra in finitely many examples but do not certify all controls or all dimensions. Prior periodic dissipation ingredients are attributed explicitly.
scientific_limitations: Proved for fixed finite chain dimension, quadratic vacancy \(1-x^2\), uniformly positive bounded measurable controls, and time-averaged terminal output. Positive constants are existential, not optimal. No aperiodic attracting orbit or pointwise convergence is claimed; independent priority and proof validation remain outstanding.
title: A uniform finite-horizon throughput budget for aperiodically driven quadratic ribosome-flow chains
